Package org.ether.society.engines.tier2.theories

package org.ether.society.engines.tier2.theories

Tier 2: Theoretical Cliodynamic & Macro-Sociological Models

Implements formal mathematical representations of seminal social science, economic, and historical paradigms:

  • Boserupian Agricultural Intensification: Population-driven technological and infrastructural yield gains.
  • Turchin & Goldstone Structural-Demographic Theory (SDT): Elite overproduction, state fiscal distress, and mass immiseration.
  • Acemoglu & Robinson Inclusive vs. Extractive Institutions: Rule of law, property rights, and institutional persistence.
  • Kummel & Ayres Exergy Model: Energy/work-constrained macroeconomic production functions.
  • Jevons Paradox & Hotelling Resource Depletion: Thermodynamic efficiency rebound and non-renewable resource extraction.
  • West & Bettencourt Urban Allometry: Superlinear metabolic scaling of cities and innovation hubs.
  • Tainter Marginal Complexity Returns: Diminishing returns on institutional complexity leading to collapse.
  • Price Multilevel Selection & Cultural Transmission: Henrich-Boyd cultural evolution and cooperative norms.
